name: Inverted Pyramid (news style)
summary: Put the most important facts first, then supporting detail, then background, so the talk can be cut at any point.
title_style: Headline titles: factual, specific, under 12 words.

sequence.purpose: Lead: who, what, when, where in one slide.
Key supporting details, most important first.
Background for those who want it.

pitfalls: Building up to the news instead of opening with it.
Background placed before the key facts.
Burying the one number people need.

example.topic: A fictional logistics company announcing a depot reopening
outline: The north depot reopens Monday after flood repairs
All 14 delivery routes resume on schedule
Pumps, power and docks passed inspection Friday
Background: the depot closed after June storms
Staff return in two shifts starting Sunday
